instruction.name: xvssrarn.bu.h
instruction.description: Arithmetic right shift with rounding each signed 16-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 16, saturate the result to unsigned 8-bit, write it into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvssrarn.bu.h $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvssrarn.bu.h $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvssrarn.bu.h $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvssrarn.bu.h $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvssrarn.bu.h $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvssrarn.bu.h $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvssrarn.bu.h $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvssrarn.bu.h $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
